caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object has an ornate, symmetrical design resembling a decorative finial or lamp base, with a broad, flaring foot, a narrow, tiered neck, and a bulbous upper section. The main body features alternating vertical panels in pastel colors including shades of blue, pink, yellow, and lavender, blending softly into each other. At the top, there is a metallic or dark gray cap with two short cylindrical elements protruding vertically. The drawing medium appears to be watercolor or colored pencil, characterized by soft, blended shading and smooth transitions between colors. In the lower right corner, there is a signature that reads "David S. DeVault."
title: Whale Oil Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
